main_body: Palm tree: a drooping frond crown on a tall segmented brown trunk
top_band: At x=15, light-to-mid green frond crown at rows 5-8 (L=144 then 82), under a dark outline at rows 2-4; dark green shadow at rows 9-10 and the trunk below
evidence: This is an organic plant. The crown reads as a lighter upper surface of fronds seen from slightly above. Darker green sits under it as shade, and the trunk (rows 11-37) is the front body. It is not a flat elevation or a rim-only piece. The drooping frond silhouette is close to a side profile, but the lit crown top is a few rows tall and I accept it as 3/4 for an organic piece.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 15 distinct colours and a median of 10 colours per tile. The references have 427 and 567 colours and a median of about 108 per tile. The outlines are tinted (0% neutral), and there are no flat fills. The fronds and trunk use only a few green and brown steps, with no clustered leaf texture and little per-segment trunk shading. Next to the lush, richly clustered reference canopies it looks thin and simplified, so it fails on density and shading depth.
